reviewers.agent: general-purpose subagent (Opus 4.8), separate context — independent second judge, traced lookback boundaries and the accuracy window

records.finding: Config.LookbackWeeks was validated (>=1) but never applied — the estimate used ALL supplied history, so a caller passing more than N weeks silently got a wider basis and the ADR-0006 'last N weeks' contract held only if some other layer pre-bounded.
records.evidence: LookbackWeeks referenced only in the <1 error path; the bucketing loop iterated all of history.
records.reason: HourOfWeek now enforces the lookback: it bounds history to the half-open window [earliest_target - 7*N days, earliest_target), dropping older-than-lookback samples and excluding samples at/after the target window. Cross-examiner traced the boundaries and confirmed the 8-week accuracy test still feeds all 8 weeks (cutoff lands exactly on base).

records.finding: The package doc claimed 'the median of the same hour over the last N non-holiday weeks' as behavior, but the code did no N-week bounding — the claim depended entirely on the caller.
records.evidence: doc.go asserted the N-week property while Expected never filtered by N.
records.reason: The code now enforces the N-week bound (see above), so the doc claim is backed by enforcement. Confirmed by the cross-examiner.

records.finding: No test pinned lookback behavior (history wider than N weeks) or the tz caveat; the config param was exercised only for its <1 error path.
records.reason: Added TestLookbackBoundsHistory (older-than-N dropped, at/after-target excluded) and TestConstantBucketYieldsZeroWidthInterval; the existing tests were rearranged so history precedes the target (realistic pre-incident history).

records.finding: A genuinely constant hour (MAD=0) yields a zero-width interval [med, med], which the unrealized leg (8.2) must decide how to treat (any nonzero deviation would read as loss with no tolerance).
records.reason: Correct for this package: a constant hour has zero normal variation. Documented and pinned by TestConstantBucketYieldsZeroWidthInterval. How the unrealized leg treats a zero-width band is 8.2's decision, noted in that test; not this package's concern.

records.finding: Latent DST/timezone assumption: the lookback cutoff uses calendar arithmetic (AddDate) while hour-of-week bucketing reads the instant's own location; across a DST transition they can disagree by an hour.
records.evidence: Cross-examiner note; tests use UTC so impl and tests agree.
records.reason: Added a v0 timezone assumption note to doc.go (fixed-offset/UTC registry timezone; DST-observing seasonality is a later refinement). No code change needed for v0.

records.finding: The accuracy test evaluated a single week while ADR-0006 specifies a 4-week evaluation window.
records.evidence: Pre-existing wording drift between the ADR and the test.
records.reason: Widened the accuracy evaluation to a 4-week window (672 target hours), each estimated from the 8 prior weeks; the <5% MAPE bar still passes.
